key_insight: Nestor combines attention-based conditional computation with MoE sparsity, improving language-model pretraining at equal compute and sparsity.
engineering_relevance: Nested sparsity may inform efficient engineering foundation models, but this paper does not demonstrate solid-mechanics or FEM-surrogate applications.
method: Introduce conditional computation that generalizes the transformer attention operator.
Hierarchically compose attention-side sparsity with MoE sparsity.
Evaluate Nestor in language-model pretraining and continual adaptation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports better pretraining performance, more effective long-context adaptation, and more efficient domain adaptation with less forgetting, with benefits persisting as model size, dataset size, and context length increase.
watch_item: Equal-compute improvements do not establish wall-clock speedups or accuracy on mechanics tasks; both require direct evaluation.
paper_title: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
